# overwrite program with shape matcher
src='''def transform(g):
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    marker = [(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0,9)]
    color = g[marker[0][0]][marker[0][1]]
    minr=min(i for i,j in marker); minc=min(j for i,j in marker)
    shape=[(i-minr,j-minc) for i,j in marker]
    mh=max(i for i,j in shape)+1; mw=max(j for i,j in shape)+1
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(h-mh+1):
        for c in range(w-mw+1):
            if all(g[r+i][c+j]==0 for i,j in shape):
                for i,j in shape: out[r+i][c+j]=color
    return out
'''
